note: Maine test cases, checked 2026-11-01. Maine publishes no per-event public CSO or SSO notices, so no row below is a discharge notice issued at the time of the event. Rows 1-3 are annual per-permittee CSO totals from the DEP CSO Status Report (event-days are calendar days with any CSO discharge). Rows 4-8 are Maine Healthy Beaches advisories at beaches DEP lists as potentially CSO-impacted; the advisory text never names a cause, so linking them to a CSO is inference. Rows 9-10 are DMR shellfish closures triggered by rainfall rules. Event time, source publication time and fetch time are kept separate.
